citations.claim: NS still green immediately before yellow
NS already red after 1s yellow, violation reported yellow lasted 1s limit 3

counterfactual.change: Changed actuated from true to false (fixed-time) keeping all other fields/steps identical; yellow then lasts full 3s and no violation occurs, proving actuated yellow-truncation causes failure.

explanation: Shrunk actuated scenario shows NS green at step 324 then NS yellow for only 1 second at step 325 before switching to all-red at step 326, violating yellow_seconds=3. Actuated controller appears to allow early termination/truncation of yellow (perhaps treating yellow as part of extensible green or recall logic). Switching actuated from true to false (fixed-time) with identical timing makes violation disappear.
vision_note: In step 324 the active approaches are green, in step 325 they turn yellow, and by step 326 the entire intersection is red on all approaches. The yellow phase is visible for only one second before the all-red clearance.
